description: The Building Bright Futures (BBF) Council of the Lamoille Valley in partnership with Let’s Grow Kids (LGK) and the VT Early Childhood Advocacy Alliance (VECAA) are planning a "Meet the Candidates Night," for Vermont House/Senate, to be held via Zoom on September 29, 2022 from 6:30-8:00 pm
title: Building Bright Futures Candidate Forum — Saudia LaMont for Vermont
